Expected charges

      
Every line a call like this normally carries, before a single figure is entered — like an Excel template's rows, waiting to be filled in. Operating instructions

        
Neither treatment below is published. Q(7) classes a container by length; Q(34) defines out-of-gauge by handling condition. Takoradi billed the issued TAK26073 otherwise, so the app can follow it — but only as a named instruction you confirm, printed on every line it touches.

        

        


        
What was read

        


        

          
          
          
        

      

      
      

        
Boxes

        
Port dues, stevedoring, craneage, overtime and terminal handling are charged per box; ISPS and PIDD per TEU — a 40' is one box but two TEU, and anything above 40' is 2.5 [Q(7)]. The Shippers' Authority levy is charged per metric ton of cargo, so enter the cargo weight for each group or that levy cannot be raised.

        

          SizeClassMovement
          BoxesTEU
          Cargo (MT)Cargo interest
        

        

      

      

      
Ordered services

      
Only add a line for a service that was actually ordered. GPHA's names differ from the trade's: opening of containers is the seal service, transport within terminal is yard positioning, additional handling is what an examination move bills under. Lift-on/lift-off does not apply where terminal handling has already been raised [Q(29)].

      

        ServiceSizeStuffed/empty
        MovementBoxes
      

      

    


    

      

  


  
  

    

    
 Packing list Prices every package on its own lift — the way the terminal does.

      
Stevedoring is charged per lift. A row reading qty 3 · 12,000 kg is three 4-tonne lifts, not one of 12 — so each package is resolved to its own weight and measurement, then priced on its own band. Per General Term C(3) the heavy-lift band applies only where weight governs; where measurement wins, the class's base rate applies to the CBM.

Every difference is listed — charges the system misses, charges it adds, amounts that disagree, and lines where the issued document's own rate × quantity does not equal its amount. Save it and the check is repeated after every future change.

 Document reading (AI)

    

      
      

        

          
          
        

      

      

        

    

    
Left unticked, the key is held for this browser session only — it is gone when you close the tab, and it is never written to disk or saved with a PDA. Tick the box and it is stored in this browser so you do not retype it; only do that on a machine you control. 

    
Without a key the app still works — paste the document text into Step 1 yourself and fill the intake by hand. The key only powers auto-fill.

 Commodities you added 

    
A document can name a cargo the tariff does not list — Bulk Wheat against the published Bulk Grains line. Adding it keeps the document's wording on the PDA while it is still priced on the tariff line it belongs to. No rate is ever invented. Remove one and anything using it falls back to that line.

Getting started

      
A PDA is a quotation you can be held to, so this app never guesses a rate and never hides its working.

    
  


  
Making a PDA, start to finish

  
The headings below are the ones on screen — the step rail at the top of a job tracks the same six. Go takes you to any of them.

  


  
Set up once

  
These three print on the document itself, so a PDA cannot be issued without them.

  


  
Four things worth knowing on day one

  
Liner terms decide who pays. They are the single most important field. Only one leg happens at your port, so the dropdown offers just the terms that mean something for that leg — Free Out, Liner Out or Full Liner Terms on an import.

  
The chip on each charge says how firm it is. Verified tariff came from the published schedule with its code. Estimate needs confirming before you issue. Pre-approval only applies if the service is used.

  
Nothing is exempted automatically. The app always levies. Where a Certificate of Exemption applies, you switch that line off — a charge dropped by the machine is a charge nobody checked.

  
Your work saves itself to this browser. Nothing leaves the machine except the text of a document you ask it to read. Use Settings → Backup before clearing browser data.
